frames.gloss: 在句子中间插入对前面名词的补充说明（人名、身份、地名）。
frames.pattern_notes: 两种形态：带逗号同位（My mother, Liu Shurong, ...）与无标点专有名词同位（the site Machu Picchu）。同位语删去后句子主干仍完整；专有名词同位常出现在职位/身份名词后。

examples.s: T F My mother, Liu Shurong, is my greatest inspiration.
The first group, the Romans, came in the first century.
The vehicle carried the astronauts Jing Haipeng and Chen Dong.
The Inca emperor lived in the now-famous site Machu Picchu.

frames.frame: 非限定性关系从句：[A], who/which [B]
frames.gloss: 对先行词追加补充信息，主句先行，逗号后接 who/which 从句。
frames.pattern_notes: 从句只作补充、删去不影响主干；限定性 which（无逗号）是变体（本批 S6157/S3378）。who 指人、which 指物，从句内可含副词（immediately）。

examples.s: The book tells us about Alexander Fleming, who discovered penicillin.
He spoke to the woman, who immediately changed her attitude.

frames.gloss: ……的原因是（why 引导的名词性从句修饰 reason）。
frames.pattern_notes: reason 与 why 是固定搭配，why 可换 that；教材中高频以 There are many reasons why... / What are the reasons why... 出现，why 从句陈述语序。

examples.s: There are many reasons why people learn a foreign language.
What are the reasons why Hunan people like spicy food?

frames.frame: 疑问词 + do you think + 陈述语序
frames.gloss: 你认为……（do you think 作插入语的特殊疑问句）。
frames.pattern_notes: 疑问词提前，do you think 插在句中，其后部分保持陈述语序而非倒装；介词可悬空（most appealing to）。S3133（Who do some people think...by）为换主语的变体；S6585 中 what 作表语故动词用 are。

examples.s: How do you think the writer feels about the topic?
What do you think the tense in the sentences expresses?
What do you think are some of the other factors?
Who do you think the painting is most appealing to?

frames.gloss: 做某事是怎样的（不定式主语外置到句尾）。
frames.pattern_notes: 区别于已有的 It is adj that（that 从句版）：此框架外置的是 to 不定式。可用于疑问（Why would it be difficult to...）与嵌入句（believes that it is important to...）。It be 后可为名词（an enjoyable experience）。

examples.s: It can be an enjoyable experience to recite these poems.
It was easy to imagine the danger ahead of them.
Why would it be difficult to deliver food and supplies?
Michael Jordan believes that it is important to help others.

frames.gloss: 使/让某人做某事（不带 to 的裸不定式补语）。
frames.pattern_notes: make 与 let 都接宾语加动词原形，不加 to；被动化时需补 to（本批未出现）。let 多用于口语允许义。

examples.s: They make students turn off social media at certain times.
B: Well, they let us ride along with some paramedics.
Example: Reporting verbs—These let the reader know who said what.

frames.gloss: 看见某人正在做某事。
frames.pattern_notes: 感官动词 see + 宾语 + 现在分词表进行中的动作（对比裸不定式表完整动作）；本框架可作宾补或名词后置修饰。S4388 为挖空练习句（预期 lie/lying）。

examples.s: They see a poor young man walking outside their house.
I saw a lot of people wearing fancy Mongolian robes.
B: I saw an injured man (lie) on the floor.

frames.gloss: 做某事（动名词短语整体作主语）。
frames.pattern_notes: 动名词短语作主语按单数处理，谓语可为 be like/can be adj/will V 等描述性谓语，常见于格言与议论文开头。属正则难捕捉的句子骨架（主语位置由整个动作占据）。

examples.s: Balancing one’s work and personal life can be rather difficult.
Mining for resources is very damaging, especially in the Arctic.
Travelling Travelling will build your confidence and broaden your horizons.

frames.gloss: ……，然后/并且……（逗号加 and 连接两个谓语/分句）。
frames.pattern_notes: 逗号 + and 的叙事推进式并列；后段可承前省略主语（and lived）甚至助动词（and our love forgotten）。S6663 中 drunk 为原句拼写（教材勘误项），保留原文。

examples.s: Night came again, and the train turned south towards Toronto.
Time is ticking away and more animals are dying out.
Some people drunk the water from the pump, and lived.
Our lives will be carried apart, and our love forgotten.

frames.gloss: ……就像……（like 引出的明喻）。
frames.pattern_notes: 谓语（is/sound/V）+ like + 名词构成明喻，格言体常成对出现（living without an aim is like sailing without a compass）；like 短语也可前置作状语（Like an impatient fool, ...）。

examples.s: Living without an aim is like sailing without a compass.
Seeing the annoying sight, he had a face like thunder.
Its beautiful melody Floats like a balloon. by Danielle Owens
Like an impatient fool, I pulled the lever backwards hard.

frames.gloss: 和……一样……（as...as 结构作后置修饰或谓语）。
frames.pattern_notes: 可作名词后置修饰（the hot springs, as colourful as rainbows）或谓语补语（wasn't as big as I had expected）；否定式 as...as 表不如。S7077 兼含 had expected 过去完成。

examples.s: Then there were the hot springs, as colourful as rainbows.
Paul sounded It wasn’t as big as I had expected.

frames.gloss: 这就是……的原因/这正是……所指。
frames.pattern_notes: this/that 回指前文整段内容，后接 why/what 从句收束段落；exactly 加强。S5559 为挖空练习句（预期填 why 或 because），句式骨架不变。

examples.s: And that is exactly what you are meant to think.
This is they want everyone to benefit from their work!

frames.gloss: 主语和谓语之间插入语篇标记或转述语。
frames.pattern_notes: 插入成分（however、they said 等评注性副词/主谓短语）夹在主谓之间，前后用逗号隔开，删去后句子主干完整。however 表对比，they said 表转述口吻降调。

examples.s: Fraud, however, has become a problem in the farm-to-table movement.
Bita Lake, however, is absolutely my favourite place in Potatso.
The autumn scenery, they said, would be absolutely picture- perfect.

frames.frame: 认知/言语动词 + (that) 从句
frames.gloss: 意识到/观察到/认为……（宾语从句，that 可省略）。
frames.pattern_notes: realise/observe/state/think/know 等动词接 that 从句，that 常省略（They think it means...）；从句保持陈述语序。是学术转述文体的基础骨架。

examples.s: Yuan Longping realised that larger fields were not the solution.
I observed that family is important to the people there.
Firstly, Ericsson stated that 10,000 hours was an average figure.
They think it means better job chances in the future.

frames.gloss: 被称为/被视为……（被动 + as 补语）。
frames.pattern_notes: be + V-ed + as 固定搭配型被动，副词 better 可插入；相关变体：be presented with（S3356）、be equipped with（S5551）。属被动堆叠里的介词保留型。

examples.s: Kexue is regarded as a moving laboratory/factory on the sea.
China’s Five-hundred-metre Aperture Spherical Telescope is better known as FAST.

frames.gloss: （到某参照点为止）已经被……。
frames.pattern_notes: 完成体与被动叠加；have been 表到现在为止（you have been given much），had been 表先于过去（homes had been destroyed）。受事作主语，施事可省。

examples.s: (Indian proverb) Be thankful, because you have been given much!
T F After decades, about 60,000 trees have been planted.
Workers built shelters for survivors whose homes had been destroyed.

frames.gloss: （过去某时）正在被……。
frames.pattern_notes: 进行体与被动叠加，强调动作当时正在进行、施事可不出现（posted by someone 可加）。S3377 为挖空练习句（预期填 judged 等），结构骨架一致。

examples.s: Mean comments were being posted by someone we didn’t know.
Gary was angry that he was being by his clothes.

frames.frame: Tomorrow, + be V-ing / be going to [V]
frames.gloss: 明天我将……（已定安排的将来表达）。
frames.pattern_notes: 将来时间词前置 + 现在进行体（am going hiking）或 be going to 表既定计划，而非临时决定；对比 will 表一般预测。

examples.s: Tomorrow, I am going hiking at the Tiger Leaping Gorge.
Tomorrow, I’m going to see the changing of the guard.

frames.frame: What are the advantages (and disadvantages) of [A]?
frames.gloss: ……有什么优缺点？（评估性讨论题模板）
frames.pattern_notes: what are + 复数名词 + of 短语的疑问骨架，pros and cons / advantages and disadvantages 同义替换；情态版 What might be the advantages of... 更显推测性。教材讨论环节高频模板。

examples.s: So, what are the pros and cons of renewable energy?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of these future careers?
What might be the advantages of living in remote areas?

frames.gloss: 帮助某人做某事（不定式符号可省）。
frames.pattern_notes: help 后的 to 可有可无；宾语可为人（help me get fit）或祈使句中省略（Help us choose...）。区别于 make/let 强制性使役的必裸形式。

examples.s: I imagine this app would help me get fit faster.
Laura needs an app that will help her get discounts.
Michael Jordan Help us choose some “Living Legends of Sports”.

frames.frame: 祈使句 + using [A]（方式分词后置）
frames.gloss: 用……来做……（指令句尾的分词方式状语）。
frames.pattern_notes: 练习指令语高频骨架：动词短语在前，using + 工具/材料短语作方式状语置于句尾；是已有框架『句首分词状语』的位置变体（分词后置）。属教材指令语域，用于任务说明。

examples.s: Combine each pair of sentences using the words in brackets.
Combine each pair of sentences using the word in brackets.
Prepare a slide presentation using the information you have found.
Paraphrase the sentences using the words and phrases in brackets.

frames.frame: 疑问词 + might + [S] [V]?（推测性提问）
frames.gloss: 为什么/什么可能会……（might 表推测的特殊疑问）。
frames.pattern_notes: 疑问句中 might 表推测性评估而非过去：Why might... be a bad idea? 邀请对方作可能性分析；常见于 Why/What might... 骨架。

examples.s: Why might so few Sami want to live in Sarek?
Why might cloning an extinct animal be a bad idea?

frames.frame: 过去进行体作背景：[时间/从句], [S] was/were [V-ing]
frames.gloss: （当时）我们正……（背景铺陈，后续句推进情节）。
frames.pattern_notes: 过去进行体提供场景背景，可由 Last year、as/when 从句引出；随后句子转入一般过去时推进情节。叙事文体的典型时体骨架。

examples.s: Last year, we were having problems in our chat room.
As we pulled up, two nurses were waiting for us.

frames.gloss: 劝说/说服某人做某事。
frames.pattern_notes: 劝说类动词接宾语 + to 不定式补语；advise 表建议、persuade 表说服成功。与 want/ask sb to do 同族。

examples.s: In Conversation 2, Carla advises Li Mei to change her.
Then I persuaded my father to see a lung specialist.

frames.frame: 过去完成体：[S] had [V-ed]（先于过去参照点）
frames.gloss: （在那之前）已经……。
frames.pattern_notes: had + 过去分词表先于过去某参照点：与 before 从句（before we went there）或过去语境（wasn't as big as I had expected）共现。S6286 为挖空练习句（预期 had heard）。

examples.s: We wanted to know where he had lost the laptop.
But I about haggis many times before we went there.

candidates.note: wh- + to 不定式作表语（My biggest headache is how to...），单句出现，值得后续验证。

example.s: My biggest headache is how to be polite in English.

candidates.note: It doesn't matter + wh- 从句（让步性评价框架），单句出现。

example.s: It doesn’t matter what dreams you have for your future.

candidates.note: 否定疑问修辞性问句（Isn't it pleasanter to...?），单句出现。

example.s: Isn’t it pleasanter to have daily duties and then relax?

candidates.note: wh- 从句作主语（Where farms were located was...），单句出现。

example.s: Where farms were located was often critical to success, too.

candidates.note: X is where + 从句（表语 where 从句），单句出现。

example.s: Buckingham Palace C is where the king or queen lives.

candidates.note: 比较级 + than + 主语 + think（sooner than you think），已知框架 more A than anyone thought 的近亲变体。

example.s: You will get over tough times sooner than you think.

candidates.note: spend + 时间 + V-ing 与 anywhere but 组合，单句出现。

example.s: They spend all their time looking anywhere but at me.

candidates.note: keep + O + V-ed/adj（keeps you updated on...），状态使役单句出现。

example.s: This app keeps you updated on all your favourite topics.

candidates.note: Have you + V-ed ... yet? 现在完成疑问，单句出现。

example.s: Have you pressed the button yet to copy the file?

candidates.note: take turns + V-ing（轮流做某事），单句出现。

example.s: Take turns giving directions to different places in the park.

candidates.note: make sure + (that) 从句；内含 be equipped with 被动介词保留。

example.s: • Make sure your home is equipped with fire extinguishers.

candidates.note: A, not B 修正式同位（Salt, not sugar），对话修正语单句出现。

example.s: “Salt, not sugar, and the cream is sour,” replied Meg.

candidates.note: 介词前置式 wh- 从句（on which day Father's Day falls），正式语体变体，单句出现。

example.s: I don’t know exactly on which day Father’s Day falls.

candidates.note: 双宾转移 give sb sth（gives him a hug），单句出现。

example.s: (Portia walks over to Roderick and gives him a hug.

candidates.note: 诗歌体：副词叠用（slowly, slowly）与分词前置（Dimming, Hiding...），文学语体骨架。

example.s: Rose slowly, slowly, Dimming, Hiding, The light of my dream.

candidates.note: 省略式/回声疑问（you start searching...?，疑为 Why don't you... 的截断），单句出现。

example.s: you start searching from the other side of the room?

candidates.note: I can safely say + that 从句（强化断言框架），单句出现。

example.s: Well, now I can safely say that I’ve been there!

candidates.note: may be A but B（让步推测：Anderson may be young but...），单句出现。

example.s: Anderson may be young but he’s certainly rolling in dough!
